nodes.name: paths.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the `.orgtrack` directory layout and provides path-builder and JSON read/write/append helpers used throughout repo_sync to persist manifest, index, session, and commit files.

nodes.name: types.rs
nodes.summary: Defines the serializable `.orgtrack` repo-shareable data model (scan progress/checkpoint, manifest, index, session/commit/provenance records, file timelines) written to and read from disk.

nodes.name: resource_interaction.rs
nodes.summary: Derives file resource interactions (read/write/create/delete/rename outcomes) from agent tool calls and activity chunks, extracting file paths from tool arguments and unified-diff patches.

nodes.name: session_usage.rs
nodes.summary: Recomputes and backfills per-session token usage and billing cost by probing native/imported session owners and aggregating token totals across the store.

nodes.name: activity.rs
nodes.summary: Converts a generic activity-record input into a canonical ActivityRecord, mapping raw event-type strings to the ActivityKind enum.

nodes.name: anthropic_jsonl.rs
nodes.summary: Source adapter that discovers, parses, and caches Anthropic API JSONL transcript files, converting message turns into normalized activity chunks and edit-impact artifacts via the shared imported_history pipeline.

nodes.name: db.rs
nodes.summary: Reads and caches Claude Code's local SQLite session index (`sessions.json`/journal), performing delta sync of session metadata and building ClaudeCodeSession records.

nodes.name: history.rs
nodes.summary: Discovers and parses Claude Code JSONL transcript files from disk, converting them into cached history records and normalized activity chunks (messages, tool calls, edits) via the imported_history pipeline.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Barrel module for the Claude Code source adapter, exposing the db and history submodules and a helper to build the canonical `claudecodeapp-` prefixed session ID.

nodes.name: history.rs
nodes.summary: Discovers and parses Cline extension session history (both JSON files and SQLite database records), converting stored transcripts into normalized activity chunks and cached session metadata.

nodes.name: ensure_orgtrack_dirs
nodes.summary: Creates the full `.orgtrack` directory tree (metadata, records, derived, state subdirectories) if it does not already exist.

nodes.name: append_json_line
nodes.summary: Appends a JSON-serialized record as a new line to a JSONL file, creating the file and parent directories as needed.

nodes.name: read_json_lines
nodes.summary: Reads and deserializes every line of a JSONL file into a vector of typed records, skipping blank lines.

nodes.name: safe_file_stem
nodes.summary: Sanitizes an arbitrary string into a filesystem-safe file stem for use in `.orgtrack` record filenames.

nodes.name: repo_relative_path
nodes.summary: Computes a file's path relative to the repo root, used to key `.orgtrack` file-timeline records.

nodes.name: clear_derived_outputs
nodes.summary: Deletes previously generated derived `.orgtrack` output files so they can be regenerated cleanly on the next sync.

nodes.name: OrgtrackScanProgress
nodes.summary: Serializable progress record tracking an in-flight `.orgtrack` repo scan's counts and phase, with a default constructor.

nodes.name: OrgtrackProvenanceRecord
nodes.summary: Serializable record linking a file change to its originating session/commit provenance for the `.orgtrack` export.

nodes.name: OrgtrackFileTimelineEntry
nodes.summary: Serializable entry in a file's `.orgtrack` timeline describing one historical change event for that file.

nodes.name: file_interactions_from_activity_chunk
nodes.summary: Derives file resource interactions (read/write/etc.) from a single normalized activity chunk.

nodes.name: interaction_outcome_from_tool_result
nodes.summary: Determines the outcome (success/failure/partial) of a file resource interaction from a tool call's result payload.

nodes.name: activity_chunk_source_event_id
nodes.summary: Extracts the originating source event ID from an activity chunk for correlating derived resource interactions back to their source event.

nodes.name: file_interactions_from_tool
nodes.summary: Central dispatcher that derives a list of FileInteractionCandidate entries from a tool name, its arguments, and optional result, covering read/write/search/patch tools.

nodes.name: action_for_tool_name
nodes.summary: Maps a known tool function name (e.g. read/edit/write file tools) to its corresponding ResourceAction classification.

nodes.name: explicit_file_paths
nodes.summary: Extracts explicitly-referenced file paths from a tool call's argument JSON (e.g. file_path/path fields).

nodes.name: patch_file_interactions
nodes.summary: Derives file interactions from a multi-file unified-diff patch tool call by parsing the patch text for touched paths.

nodes.name: recompute_session_usage
nodes.summary: Recomputes a session's aggregate token usage and estimated cost by probing native and imported usage sources and summing native totals.

nodes.name: backfill_session_usage
nodes.summary: Backfills missing session_usage rows for historical sessions that predate usage tracking, by recomputing usage for each affected session.

nodes.name: SessionUsageRecord
nodes.summary: Record of a session's aggregate token usage (input/output/cache) and billable-token computation used for cost estimation and reporting.

nodes.name: activity_record_from_input
nodes.summary: Converts a generic ActivityRecordInput into a canonical ActivityRecord ready for storage.

nodes.name: activity_kind_from_event_type
nodes.summary: Maps a raw event-type string from a source adapter into the canonical ActivityKind enum variant.

nodes.name: ActivityRecordInput
nodes.summary: Provider-neutral input struct capturing the raw fields needed to build a canonical ActivityRecord from any source adapter.

nodes.name: load_session
nodes.summary: Loads and parses a single Anthropic JSONL transcript file from disk into normalized activity chunks for a session.

nodes.name: parse_session_meta
nodes.summary: Parses an Anthropic JSONL transcript file's lines into session metadata (title, timestamps, token usage, edit-impact stats) for caching.

nodes.name: read_turns
nodes.summary: Reads a JSONL file's lines and groups them into TranscriptTurn structures representing a message and its associated events.

nodes.name: messages_to_chunks
nodes.summary: Converts parsed Anthropic transcript turns into the shared imported_history activity chunk format (user/assistant/thinking/tool-call chunks).

nodes.name: delta_sync
nodes.summary: Performs an incremental sync of Claude Code's local sessions index against the cache, fetching only sessions whose mtimes changed since the last sync.

nodes.name: parse_session_jsonl
nodes.summary: Parses a Claude Code session's JSONL journal file to extract assistant messages and token usage for building a ClaudeCodeSession record.

nodes.name: query_cache
nodes.summary: Queries the local session cache database for previously indexed Claude Code sessions matching given filters.

nodes.name: ClaudeCodeSession
nodes.summary: Struct representing a Claude Code session as read from its local SQLite/JSON index, including metadata needed for canonical import.

nodes.name: stat_claude_code_history_for_session
nodes.summary: Retrieves file-stat metadata (size, mtime) for a Claude Code session's transcript file without fully parsing it.

nodes.name: sync_claude_code_history_cache
nodes.summary: Syncs the imported-history cache with newly discovered or changed Claude Code transcript files on disk.

nodes.name: load_claude_session_titles
nodes.summary: Loads session title metadata for Claude Code sessions from their project directories, used to populate sidebar/history listings.

nodes.name: parse_claude_session_meta
nodes.summary: Parses a Claude Code transcript file end-to-end to derive session metadata (title, timestamps, token usage, edit impact) for caching, calling into the shared imported_history normalization helpers.

nodes.name: collect_claude_impact_from_item
nodes.summary: Accumulates edit-impact statistics (lines changed) from a single Claude Code transcript item's tool result.

nodes.name: load_claude_code_history_from_path
nodes.summary: Fully loads and normalizes a Claude Code transcript file into the shared activity-chunk format (user/assistant/thinking/tool-call chunks) for a given session path.

nodes.name: claude_projects_dir_candidates
nodes.summary: Enumerates candidate filesystem locations for Claude Code's `projects` directory across supported OS/install layouts.

nodes.name: ClaudeJsonlLine
nodes.summary: Struct modeling a single line of a Claude Code transcript JSONL file (message, metadata, tool events).

nodes.name: canonical_session_id
nodes.summary: Builds the canonical `claudecodeapp-`-prefixed session ID from a Claude Code source session ID, used to correlate hook events with imported history.

nodes.name: discover_cline_history_records
nodes.summary: Discovers Cline session history files on disk (JSON transcripts) and produces discovered-record descriptors for cache syncing.

nodes.name: discover_cline_db_records
nodes.summary: Discovers Cline sessions stored in its SQLite database and produces discovered-record descriptors for cache syncing.

nodes.name: parse_cline_session_meta
nodes.summary: Parses a Cline session transcript to derive session metadata (title, timestamps, token usage, edit impact) for caching, using the shared imported_history normalization helpers.

nodes.name: transcript_to_chunks
nodes.summary: Converts a parsed Cline transcript into the shared imported_history activity chunk format (user/assistant/tool-call chunks), stripping Cline-specific read-tool gutter formatting.

nodes.name: expand_cline_tool_call
nodes.summary: Expands a compact Cline tool-call representation into its full normalized tool-call chunk with input/output details.
